textbookBox.concept: Sums of consecutive numbers show patterns: 2 + 3 = 5 and 3 + 4 + 5 = 12, and every odd number is the sum of two consecutive numbers.

textbookBox.concept: If we put plus and minus signs between four numbers in all 8 ways, every result has the same parity, because changing a plus to a minus changes the value by an even number.
